title: My 8 year old son created his first game with Google Antigravity
author: RealMrBoon
selftext:
My 8 year old son has just coded his first video game with the help of Google Gemini.

He's been coding & designing together with Gemini for about 2 weeks. It's been a very fun process for him where he's learned so much.

His game is now finished and online on: [https://supersnakes.io](https://supersnakes.io/) (ad-free)

He is very curious to hear what you guys think about his game. Anyone looking to start coding with the help of AI should really try Google Antigravity. It allows even young kids to launch projects now.

comments.author: AnObscureGame
comments.body: Your EIGHT year old son coded an *entire* multiplayer game in 2 weeks, with visuals, sound, and UI?

replies.author: caxco93
replies.body: well the llm just needs to basically spit out one of the multiple slither io repos available

replies.author: RealMrBoon
replies.body: The LLM did most the heavy lifting indeed, it came up with a very very basic version initially. 200 prompts later, lots of refinement, bug fixes, changes, this is the final result.

replies.author: MuXu96
replies.body:
There is literally no heavy lifting by yours or your kids side, heavy lifting is literally impossible at that age.

I don't mean to be mean, is still awesome to be interested in this early and I'm very sure if he / she keeps at it and stays interested there will be a looooot of heavy lifting from him at an early age, earlier that most started here.

replies.body:
Gotta start em young. Love unpaid child labor

comments.body: Typical low performer. My 5yo basically created Google Antigravity. But I have to say, was a stressful week for him, missing a total of 5 midday naps.

comments.author: japanesealexjones
comments.body: Not impressed. My 2 month old son vibe coded a better version of no man sky. Also manufactured his own RAM. Currently CEO of his company and all over the news.

comments.author: icekiller333
comments.body: That's awesome :) I hope he had a bunch of fun!

comments.author: Shnatrix
comments.body:
Massive Kudos to you and your son - that's amazing, it's fun, simple, interactive and enjoyable.  
I just had a few rounds and it's easy to pick up and play and it's a complete product. 

Something even large dev's don't release!

Well done, keep climbing and love to see what you guys do next!

comments.author: RemarkableGuidance44
comments.body:
The hate here is amazing because its going to get easier and easier to make games that anyone can make them.   
  
Most people who make games make ZERO dollars, even with AI help, you're not becoming a millionaire.

This game is more polished then most of the shared AI slop on this Sub... Then again most of this sub are people trying to sell their garbage AI App.

If your son did make it, great!

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: This is amazing! An 8-year-old coding and designing a full game in just two weeks is impressive. Tooks great, and it’s clear he’s learning a lot while having fun. For even more feedback and suggestions from a coding community, consider sharing his project on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com), it’s a great place to get ideas and encouragement.
